Distance from hospital with continuous cesarean capability
driving distance from a hospital with continuous cesarean capability
cohort: 11,869 individuals who planned to give birth at home in Ontario, Canada, between April 1, 2012, and March 31, 2015
finding: There was no increased risk of adverse neonatal outcomes for births planned to occur more than 30 minutes from a hospital.
